description: A favicon / webmanifest / viewport standard. Static checks verify `<link rel="manifest">`, icon links, a viewport meta tag, and `"display":"standalone"` in the webmanifest. Auto-fix can insert the standard tags (safe fixer).

requirements.description: Static checks must verify the presence of `<link rel="manifest">`, icon links, a viewport meta tag, and `"display":"standalone"` in the webmanifest. Each missing element must produce a Finding.
requirements.title: Static favicon/manifest/viewport checks

validation.notes: A missing <link rel="manifest"> produces a Finding
Missing icon links or viewport meta tag each produce a Finding
A webmanifest missing "display":"standalone" produces a Finding
Run ui-health against a scenario missing the viewport meta and confirm the Finding is emitted
The favicon/manifest/viewport standard ensures installable, correctly-scaled UIs

requirements.description: A safe auto-fixer must be able to insert the standard favicon/manifest/viewport tags into the document. The fixer must be idempotent: re-running it does not duplicate tags.
requirements.title: Safe insert-tags fixer idempotent

validation.notes: The insert-tags fixer adds missing manifest, icon, and viewport tags
Re-running the fixer does not duplicate already-present tags (idempotent)
The insert-tags fixer is marked safe with autofix_available true
Run the fixer and confirm the favicon/manifest/viewport Findings clear on re-validate with no duplicate tags
Safe tag insertion makes the favicon/manifest/viewport standard auto-remediable

title: favicon / webmanifest / viewport standard
